snippet.title: Tiger Shroff Firing Case: 3 Accused Arrested in Kota | Names Revealed | What We Know So Far
snippet.description:
Tiger Shroff Firing Case: Three accused arrested in Kota, Rajasthan, in connection with the firing at Bollywood actor Tiger Shroff’s car in Mumbai’s Juhu area.

The accused have been identified as Phool Singh, Hrithik Kumar alias Roshan, and Rehan. According to media reports, the three were apprehended at Kota railway station while travelling by train from Mumbai towards Delhi. Reports identify Phool Singh and Rehan as residents of Haryana, while Hrithik Kumar is reported to be a Rapido rider who was living in Andheri West, Mumbai.

The firing took place on Sunday evening, October 18, as Tiger Shroff was leaving a football venue in Juhu. The actor escaped direct gunshot injuries, while his driver and another person were reported injured.

The investigation is also examining a claim attributed to members linked to the Lawrence Bishnoi gang. Authorities have been investigating the circumstances of the shooting, the alleged roles of the accused and any possible links to a wider criminal network. The gang’s responsibility claim should be treated as an allegation unless independently established by investigators.

snippet.title: 【ニュース】デモ暴徒化したフランス大荒れ　歴史的建造物が放火され全焼　各地で略奪も #shorts
snippet.description:
フランス全土で17日に行われた大規模なデモ。物価高への抗議や教育環境の改善などを訴え、およそ55万人が参加したといいます。

　緊迫した状況は翌日も続きました。

　17日はデモに乗じて車に火をつけたり、店舗を襲ったりするなど各地で破壊行為が相次ぎました。

■黒ずくめ集団　略奪行為も

　行動はエスカレートし、略奪行為も…。北部のリールでは、スーパーマーケットが襲われ、店内の商品が次々と外へ投げ出されていました。

　パリでも、下ろされたシャッターの隙間から商品とみられるものを次々と持ち去る黒ずくめの集団の姿がありました。

　フランス内務省の発表によると、これまでにおよそ2400人が逮捕・拘束され、警官や憲兵ら1000人近くが負傷したということです。
